summary: Delay in deposit of balance sale consideration; 853 days unexplained absence of sufficient cause; failure to pay within statutory period; rescission of agreement to sell under Specific Relief Act; interest at 18% p.a. awarded by trial court; V.S. Palanichamy Chettiar precedent distinguishing lack of readiness/willingness; appeal allowed restoring rescission.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 28 of the Specific Relief Act, 1963
Section 148 of the Code of Civil Procedure
V.S. Palanichamy Chettiar Firm v. C. Alagappan and Another, (1999) 4 SCC 702
Kishor Ghanshyamsa Paralikar (D) through Lrs. V. Balaji Mandir Sansthan Mangrul
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; trial court order condoning delay and directing deposit of Rs. 15,00,000/- with 18% interest set aside; agreement to sell rescinded; costs awarded.
